25 Indian men trapped in Myanmar cyber fraud scheme

A group of 25 Indian men from Maharashtra have been lured into a cyber fraud scheme in Myanmar, where they were allegedly tortured and forced to participate. The victims were targeted through online trading scams and lost significant amounts of money. Authorities have arrested the perpetrators, but concerns remain about the treatment of the victims.
